The player must navigate near the lever (within 8 blocks, which means being inside or at the entrance of the building) and face toward it (within 60 degrees). This correctly models 'player can see the lever' without requiring them to stand on an exact spot.

scene_description: A grass field with a stone brick building (~4,0,4 to ~9,3,9) containing a lever on the inner south wall. The building has a 2-block-wide doorway on the west face. Torches are placed outside to guide the player toward the entrance. A cobblestone structure is placed nearby as a distractor landmark.
task_text: Find the lever hidden inside the stone brick building. Explore the area, locate the doorway, enter the building, and look at the lever.
design_notes: The stone brick building is at relative +4 to +9 in X and Z from spawn, about 5-9 blocks away. The doorway faces west (toward the player), 2 blocks wide. The lever is on the inner east wall at ~7 ~1 ~7 (facing south). Torches at ~2,0,5 and ~2,0,7 mark the path to the entrance. The cobblestone structure at ~-3 to ~-1 serves as a distractor. The lever is the ONLY lever in the scene, making verification unambiguous.
